name: SH Feature Encoding
definition: A method to encode view direction for modeling view-dependent effects by multiplying each Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficient by a feature vector, rather than using vanilla SH encoding.
summary: SH Feature Encoding models view-dependent effects by multiplying each Spherical Harmonics coefficient with a learnable feature vector, differing from vanilla SH encoding by using per-coefficient vectors predicted from spatial features.
